To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the current forensic tools are unable to accurately identify the presence of deleted files, deleted data and deleted file system metadata.
the current forensic tools are unable to detect and recover deleted data, and the data recovery tools can recover only a portion of the deleted data.

our novel proposed anti-forensics approaches are effective in thwarting the data acquisition process of contemporary forensic tools, and the forensic tools are unable to detect the presence of our proposed anti forensic approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of anti-forensic methods that can be used in a forensics investigation to prevent the recovery of deleted files.
the development of novel approaches to thwart the digital forensics process and to provide the necessary tools to the forensic investigators to counter the anti-forensic attacks.
the design and implementation for the three novel anti- forensics approaches for smart phones, and their effectiveness is evaluated by the three market-leading forensication tools.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our anti-forensic methods have been successfully implemented to bypass the data acquisition and analysis process of the three leading forensic tools.
current forensic tools are not equipped to handle anti-forensic methods, which can be easily applied to circumvent forensic data collection, analysis, and presentation.
current forensic tools are not reliable enough to produce accurate results in the face of these novel anti-forensics attacks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the current state of forensic tools are not capable of providing reliable and trustworthy results and that the current forensic tools are easily circumvented and manipulated.
the current state of the art forensic tools are vulnerable to our proposed anti-foresnic techniques.
the forensic tools are not as reliable as we thought and they can be easily fooled by the anti-forensic techniques we have developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current forensics tools are not able to detect and prevent the deletion or alteration of data on the phone.
the design, implementation and evaluation of novel anti-forensics approaches is a critical step in the advancement of digital forensics.
forensic data acquisition and data analysis tools must be redesigned to ensure the integrity and accuracy of the data they collect and process.
